card.title: Xbox Series X

claims.statement: Xbox Series X part numbers: NB7N621M HDMI retimer/redriver, M1087810 HDMI connector, 20535-010E-02 I-PEX 'nexus' FPC connector, M1094652-005 power/eject FFC, M1094651-009 USB/bind FFC, M1105938-001 USB/bind front connector; U21 is the HDMI ESD booster IC.
Overheating/overvoltage can damage 12 V (TPCC8131) and 5 V components; the HDMI port is mechanically weak.

card.caveats: HDMI diode reference values are in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
